sections.heading: Introduction
sections.text: Gunsmith - MP-133 is a Quest in Escape from Tarkov.

sections.heading: Dialogue
sections.text: "Hello, mercenary. Let's get straight to it. I've got clients requesting some rather specific weapon builds. Lately, the orders have been piling up, and to make matters worse, my PLC100 programmer has broken down. I'm completely out of time. You know your way around firearms, so I could use your help. Take this MP-133 shotgun. I need it modified to meet the following requirements: ergonomics at least 45, a laser sight, magazine tube capacity over 5, and combined recoil below 850. Keep it compact - no more than 4 slots. Bring it back when you're done, and I'll pay you for the work."

sections.heading: Objectives
sections.text: - Modify an MP-133 to comply with the given specifications

sections.heading: Rewards
sections.text:
- +3,000 EXP
- Mechanic Rep +0.1
- 80,000 Roubles
  - 84,000 Roubles with Intelligence Center Level 1
  - 92,000 Roubles with Intelligence Center Level 2
"You've got it? Excellent. I knew I could count on you."

sections.heading: Guide
sections.text:
MP-133 specifications:
- 60 Durability
- 45 or greater ergonomics
- 850 or less recoil
- 4 or fewer cells of space
- A magazine with a capacity of at least 5
- Any tactical device (such as the NcSTAR Tactical Blue Laser)

sections.heading: Build
sections.text: This is one example of many possible configurations.

sections.heading: Notes:
sections.text:
- This build is based on a standard MP-133 from Jaeger LL1.
- The quest check mark is not consistent even when all requirements are met, it not being present doesn't mean the gun can't be handed over.
